answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, reset on any identity-link attempt, rewards vest against future work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the spiral of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the forge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the echo re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
